title: Three QuagMirror drafts and their actual stopping points
reader_title: How far three mirror-alphabet programs actually read
reader_intro: Run three drafts of QuagMirror, a method that uses tables of rearranged runes to change each input rune. Compare their outputs and where each program stops on the same 729 runes from LP2-00 to LP2-02.
question: What do the pinned original, version-4 and WIP QuagMirror scripts output under their own fixed rules, and how much of LP2-00–02 does each process?
reader_question: Do the other QuagMirror drafts continue into a complete reading?
summary: Runs three pinned public QuagMirror scripts unchanged and compares their numeric and Latin output streams with the exact LP2-00–02 input.
finding: The original, version-4 and WIP drafts process 153, 49 and 500 of 729 source runes. They print some wordlike fragments but none reaches the end of its input, and no planted recovery control or held-out reading is supplied.
limitations: The scripts are separate drafts with handwritten tables and different recurrences. Exact output agreement does not establish a decipherment. Source version 4's skip at index 17 does not advance its loop counter, so its 48-index stop occurs after 49 input positions. This record does not choose new mirror rules or extend any script past its own stop.
next_steps: A complete proposal should freeze one transition rule for every position, process the entire stated page range, demonstrate recovery on a planted message, and check an untouched manuscript span without retuning.

scope.representation: The source's 729 zero-based rune indices, equal to the concatenated LP2-00–02 transcription after normalizing the J-rune glyph alias; source-specific 29-entry mirrors and Latin fragment mapping.
scope.procedure: Execute each pinned script without editing its stop, skip list or tables; extract its ciphertext, autokey and plaintext-index rows and complete formatted output; independently compare source input with manuscript pages, nine mirror permutations and transliteration.
scope.parameters: Pinned commit 88ef1e60b0738b8b28db96bc9dc44dc4da8dd307; original stops at 153 positions, version 4 at 49 because of its counter behavior, and WIP at 500; no searched wordlist or retuned alphabet.
scope.exclusions: Positions beyond each source stop, other QuagMirror revisions, alternative initial states, regenerated mirror tables, a new complete decryption rule, planted-recovery power and held-out manuscript validation.

review.reviewer: Pinned executable replay with independent source-input, mirror-table and output-format checks

reproduction.environment: Python 3 with SymPy 1.14 or compatible sieve.mobiusrange; the three source files are bundled and run offline.

visuals.caption: All three scripts stop before the end of their shared LP2-00–02 input.
